full_page.content:
1935, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 351 Cont.
May 22 Josephine Starek - 32 - of Cleveland - has husband & four small children to care - nervous break-down. At services Early in April (here) and felt decided relief. Asks prayers of thanks- giving.
Ludwig Starek - 30 - mentally weak prayers asked for improve- ment or cure so that he be able to return home.
Mrs. Sarah Coughlin - 60 - bad skin - swallow - 13 yrs. trouble. Corrie (Wm.) Barnes - n.c. - comething like arthritis ..... Joseph Dubusschere - 37 - out of work a long time - saucy to Mother.
Page 352 May 22 Cather McGeary -27 - Thanksgiving for cure eczema .... doctors had little of hope of a cure.
Donald Raymo - 21 - had been fearfully epileptic, was brought to about 2 o'. Drs. some of them positive nothing could be cone. About 3 yrs. ago enrolled perpetual in Ser. Mass A. and immediate- ly improved. Now O.K. and praying for work. Enrolls again per- petually this time for success in "landing a position."
24 Mrs. Emma Holtzlander - 69 - raised methodist - very much infected eye - almost blind - reads her bible and prays night prayer. - lost husband some time ago & Son recently - inscribed To-day in Ser. Mass A.
Harold Solke - 12 - invalid 11 yrs. Mrs Johanna Ryan - 71 - very low, anxious ...... Mrs. Mary Lafferty - 65 - stomach - gall-bl. - diabetis.
Page 353 May 28 Wm. A. Horan - 49 - of Wyandotte - cancer of Jaw & roof of mouth - has wife and 3 small children.
Mrs. Anna Derezich - 49 - G. Orthodox - going blind last four years now tatally blind - nerves said to be dead ....
